title: ADMIN可重置SUPER_ADMIN密码并取得其身份
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: 有效ADMIN访问令牌
默认ADMIN role seed已应用
callPath: JWT authentication and DB permission loading
password and mustChangePassword updated; refresh tokens revoked

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated PostgreSQL with real ADMIN JWT; not rerun this turn. Saw reset 200, new login SUPER_ADMIN, privileged endpoint 200 while mustChangePassword=true.
Current source same baseline; code read this turn.

counterevidenceChecked: Password length/weak password validation
Refresh-token revocation
mustChangePassword flag and separate force password endpoint
audit metadata attempted but writeAudit swallows storage errors
observedImpact: With a valid default ADMIN session, operator can reset SUPER_ADMIN password and log in as SUPER_ADMIN; historical probe reached privileged backup/restore table endpoint.
potentialImpact: Password update and refresh revocation are independent calls; if revocation fails after password update, previous refresh token may remain valid. This failure was not injected in this package.
recommendation: Check actor and target rank/protected account in the backend command; enforce force-change mode server-side across business routes; define transactional/recoverable semantics for credential write, session revocation and required audit.
acceptanceCriteria: ADMIN reset of SUPER_ADMIN is rejected and causes no credential/session changes
Permitted normal-target reset invalidates old refresh sessions
force-change user cannot use ordinary business endpoints
revocation/audit failure has documented consistent state semantics
pendingQuestions: Confirm whether target-rank protection applies to same/higher role accounts generally.

title: Role create whitelist conflicts with global code blacklist
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Actor has roles.create; default ADMIN lacks it and SUPER_ADMIN has it.
callPath: code rejected before required-field check and role insert

evidence.limitation: Historical probe returned 400 with forbidden code error; not rerun.
Current source call order explains historical response.

counterevidenceChecked: Global code ban protects against mass assignment but conflicts with this route-specific whitelist
Role create is gated; default ADMIN is excluded
Permission assignment separately permits only P0, consistent with the frozen P1 policy
observedImpact: A valid role create request containing required code is rejected with HTTP 400.
potentialImpact: Custom role creation via this API is unavailable; direct database provisioning not assessed.
recommendation: Use command-specific DTO/policies: this command accepts code while unrelated client-controlled fields remain rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized valid code/name returns 201 and isSystem=false
Duplicate/invalid code rejected
Client cannot set id, permission links or audit/system fields
pendingQuestions: Confirm whether custom roles are intended to be assignable to users; role creation creates custom role but user binding route accepts SYSTEM_ROLES only.

title: 临时登录锁定实际永久生效（到期不自动解锁）
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: 用户达到5次失败登录
系统把status设为LOCKED并写lockedUntil=当前时间+15分钟
时间过去后用户尝试正确密码登录

source.symbol: login lookup, lock gate, failure update and success reset
manual status enable clears lock fields

callPath: status LOCKED OR lockedUntil in future check
5th failed password writes failedLoginAttempts=5, lockedUntil=now+15m and status=LOCKED
subsequent login rejects on status LOCKED even after lockedUntil expires
administrator must set status ACTIVE to restore login

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated route/database evidence returned 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED after lockedUntil was in the past; not rerun this turn.
Current source confirms the expired-time status short-circuit and manual ACTIVE recovery. Failure counter interleaving was not dynamically examined.

counterevidenceChecked: There is a users.enable status path that can restore ACTIVE and clears failed attempts and lockedUntil.
Password change clears lockedUntil but does not change LOCKED status.
DISABLED is explicitly rejected before password comparison.
observedImpact: Historical evidence shows an expired timed lock still rejects correct credentials; source provides no automatic LOCKED-to-ACTIVE transition. Manual account enable is required.
recommendation: Separate administrative disable from timed lock, or explicitly transition an expired timed lock back to ACTIVE before password validation; make failure counter updates atomic and retain auditability.
acceptanceCriteria: The fifth failure enters the documented lock state.
At expiry, the documented automatic or manual recovery flow succeeds with correct credentials.
DISABLED remains rejected.
Successful login clears failure count and timed-lock data.

title: 刷新令牌并发可双重消费，TTL响应也不准确
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: POST /api/auth/refresh; access-token TTL contract in login and refresh responses
preconditions: Same unexpired refresh token is submitted by two requests
Both requests read it before either revokes it
Configured access TTL differs from fixed response expiresIn=7200

source.symbol: login and refresh token responses; refresh read/revoke/issue sequence
access TTL parser and JWT signer

callPath: Refresh hash lookup and validity check
insert a new refresh token with a newly randomized familyId
no encompassing transaction or compare-and-set result check

evidence.limitation: Historical controlled interleaving observed both requests return 200 with two successor tokens; the tested JWT was 900 seconds while response advertised 7200. Not rerun.
Current source still separates lookup, revoke, issue and gives every successor an independent familyId. Frontend single-flight is local to one module instance only.

counterevidenceChecked: Frontend merges concurrent 401 refresh attempts inside one tab/module instance.
Refresh rows store revokedAt and expiresAt; these validate each request but do not arbitrate concurrent winners.
Frontend does not consume the expiresIn response field.
observedImpact: Historical requests created two successor refresh tokens from one old token; the response TTL differed from signed TTL. Cross-tab client effects are tracked separately as N-R02-01.
recommendation: Use a transaction and conditional update where revokedAt is null, inspect affected row count, and issue the successor only for the winner. Preserve a stable family relationship and define replay response. Return the signed access TTL rather than a constant.
acceptanceCriteria: Controlled concurrent use of one refresh token yields at most one successor.
A replay follows documented family-level response and cannot create another active branch.
Any failure after consuming a token leaves a recoverable, observable session outcome.
Response expiresIn equals the access JWT remaining lifetime.

title: 跨tab刷新失败可清除已轮换的新会话
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: frontend Axios response interceptor refresh flow after a 401
preconditions: Two same-origin tabs hold the same refresh token in localStorage
Both tabs trigger refresh before either observes the other's update
One request stores the rotated token before the other tab's old-token request fails

source.symbol: refresh failure clears token store and emits session expiry

callPath: Each tab has a distinct module-scoped inflight variable
both can read same refresh token from shared localStorage
one tab rotates and writes new token
its interceptor catch unconditionally clears shared token storage

evidence.limitation: Static cross-tab control-flow inference only; no browser run this turn.

counterevidenceChecked: Single-flight does coalesce requests within one module instance.
No cross-tab lock, broadcast-based refresh coordination, or conditional clear is present in the reviewed tokenStore/http code.
observedImpact: An old refresh request that fails after another tab has stored a valid successor can remove that successor from shared localStorage and cause an unnecessary local logout. No unauthorized access gain is established.
recommendation: Coordinate rotation across tabs and make failure cleanup conditional on the failed token still being the current token; use server replay tolerance only with an explicit bounded contract.
acceptanceCriteria: In two-browser-context controlled response ordering, a losing old-token response cannot clear a newer stored token.
A genuinely invalid current refresh still clears local session and routes to login.

title: 改密或管理员重置未即时撤销已签发access JWT
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: A user has a still-valid access JWT
That user's password is changed by self-service or administrator reset
The account remains ACTIVE

source.symbol: self-service password update and refresh-token revocation
admin password reset and refresh-token revocation
JWT authentication checks status but no password/session version

callPath: old access JWT remains cryptographically valid
authenticate verifies JWT and current ACTIVE user but does not compare iat/passwordChangedAt or lookup a session revocation marker

evidence.limitation: Static call-path conclusion. Exact remaining acceptance window depends on deployed access TTL; no request replay was run.

counterevidenceChecked: Disabled/locked users are rejected on each authenticated request.
System role and permissions are reloaded from current DB state per request, so role changes are not frozen in the token.
Refresh tokens are revoked after password update, but access JWTs are not.
observedImpact: A holder of an already-issued access token can keep using it for the remaining token lifetime after password change/reset; max duration depends on configured access TTL.
recommendation: Define whether password change/reset requires immediate session invalidation. If yes, enforce a session version or server-side revocation contract on each request and keep credential update, refresh revocation, and audit failure semantics recoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: After the chosen contract window, old access and refresh credentials are both rejected following self-change and administrator reset.
New login using the resulting password works and must-change behavior remains enforced according to policy.
pendingQuestions: Confirm whether self-password change and administrator reset must invalidate existing access sessions immediately, and specify the maximum allowed delay.

title: 项目编辑通过嵌套数组替换绕过子实体删除权限并物理删除任务
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: PUT /api/projects/:id with tasks and/or milestones arrays
preconditions: Actor has projects.update and project write capability
Request contains replacement tasks or milestones array
Actor lacks the corresponding dedicated delete authority in the demonstrated case

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated route/database probe; dedicated task DELETE was 403 while project PUT array replacement was 200 and task row was physically absent; not rerun.
Current source confirms task delete path and analogous milestone path; associated-row cascade counts were not measured.

counterevidenceChecked: Project member/write capability is checked.
Nested operations are inside one transaction, so failure rolls back transaction changes.
Dedicated task deletion has its own permission route; nested replacement checks only project write.
observedImpact: Historical probe proved a project editor without task delete permission could physically remove a task via tasks:[] in project PUT.
potentialImpact: Physical replacement can alter IDs and associated data according to FK behavior; exact dependent-row effects were not measured in this packet.
recommendation: Replace full-array delete/recreate with ID-based delta commands that authorize each create/update/delete and preserve tombstone/sync semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Actor without tasks.delete cannot remove tasks through any project update payload.
Updates preserve unchanged task IDs and associations.
Authorized deletion creates the documented tombstone or equivalent sync event.

title: 项目状态与模板基准日期从未选取这些字段的授权投影读取
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Project update or template apply reaches resolveProjectAccess
Status transition needs current project status; template without explicit startDate needs project startDate
callPath: transition rejects undefined status or template falls back to current date

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated probe observed status transition 400 with undefined in error; template date output not separately dynamically verified.
Current select and consumers confirm missing fields; no new dynamic run.

counterevidenceChecked: Project schema defines both status and startDate.
The resolver's explicit select does not include either field.
The route does not separately reload these business fields before use.
observedImpact: Historical legal PLANNING to IN_PROGRESS transition was rejected with error reporting undefined current state.
potentialImpact: Template application without explicit startDate uses fallback date rather than stored Project.startDate; current output not replayed this turn.
recommendation: Separate authorization context from typed business snapshot and fetch each command's required fields explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Legal project status transition succeeds and illegal transition remains rejected.
Template without explicit date derives schedule from stored project startDate.
Ordinary edit with unchanged status remains valid.

title: 创建项目及其阶段任务里程碑分步提交，失败可留下半成品
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Actor can create projects
A later child create fails after project.create has committed

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated DB fault probe observed HTTP 500 with committed project and zero tasks; not rerun.
Current source has no encompassing transaction or cleanup across these writes.

counterevidenceChecked: Project and its owner/manager/member rows are nested in one project.create call.
That nested create does not include phases/tasks/milestones.
Audit occurs only after child writes and is outside the child sequence transaction boundary.
observedImpact: Historical child foreign-key failure returned 500 while the project remained committed and task count was zero.
potentialImpact: Client retry can create a duplicate project; retry behavior and sequence gaps were not dynamically measured.
recommendation: Validate all child input and create the full project aggregate in one transaction, with explicit retry/idempotency and audit recovery semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Fault at each child write leaves no partial project aggregate.
Retry with same idempotency key does not duplicate project or children.
Audit/recovery outcome is observable when audit cannot share the transaction.

title: 软删除项目仍进入普通项目列表和统计过滤范围
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Actor is authorized for projects.view and can see the project's membership scope
Project has deletedAt set
callPath: list/groupBy where has no deletedAt predicate

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated route probe observed listCount 1 and detailStatus 404; statistics not separately probed.
Current list/stats source confirms missing deletedAt condition; sync/search not fully reviewed in this package.

counterevidenceChecked: projectVisibilityFilter correctly scopes non-SUPER_ADMIN to manager or active member.
Detail resolver rejects missing or soft-deleted projects.
List counts only active child tasks but does not filter the project itself.
observedImpact: Historical probe returned a soft-deleted project in the list while detail returned 404.
potentialImpact: Type/status statistics can include deleted projects; not separately observed dynamically.
recommendation: Compose an alive-project scope with visibility scope and reuse it for list, count, search and statistics; isolate recycle-bin queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Soft-deleted projects are absent from list, total count, search and ordinary statistics.
Detail continues returning not found for deleted projects.
Dedicated recycle-bin query, if present, remains explicit.

title: 注册项目入口绕过项目成员边界
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Authenticated actor with registrations.view for reads
Authenticated actor with registrations.update for demonstrated update path
Target is a live registration subtype project outside actor membership

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated PostgreSQL route probe with injected actor identity; not rerun this turn and not a full real-JWT flow.
Current code confirms shared missing membership/capability check; list/stats/stage/profile were not individually dynamically probed.

counterevidenceChecked: Authentication and route-level system permission are enforced.
Queries exclude non-registration and soft-deleted projects.
Stage transitions are allowlisted and generic profile paths reject direct stage changes.
Ordinary projects use membership visibility/access resolver; registration routes do not.
observedImpact: Historical isolated probe read a private task through registration detail as a nonmember and updated a project name through registration PUT with the required system permission.
potentialImpact: Other registration routes share the same scope helper; their exact response and mutation effects have not each been dynamically demonstrated.
recommendation: Apply the shared live-project visibility and project capability decision to registration list, stats, detail, update, stage, and profile operations; define any global registration visibility exception and align manager transfer with ProjectMember state.
acceptanceCriteria: Test list/stats/detail/update/stage/profile for missing system permission, member capability, nonmember, left member, deleted project, and SUPER_ADMIN exception.
Unauthorized operations return the documented status and leave project/profile state unchanged.
SUPER_ADMIN nonmember access follows the shared elevated audit policy.
Manager transfer updates or deliberately preserves membership according to an explicit policy.
pendingQuestions: Is registration project visibility intentionally global for actors with registrations.view? If so, define read fields, write scope, and audit policy.

title: 同步拉取只按项目范围过滤，未实施实体查看权限
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Authenticated user can see a project
User lacks the corresponding entity view permission
The entity row is within the since window

source.symbol: sync init query loop and ACL response

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated route probe: online task detail 403 but sync init 200 included task; no rerun.
Current pull loop does not use entity permission metadata; same-project permission revocation cache handling is source-confirmed but not dynamically exercised.

counterevidenceChecked: Authentication is required.
Project IDs are visibility-scoped.
Reports have ownOnly author filtering.
ACL response contains permission codes but query loop does not use them.
observedImpact: Historical actor lacking entity view permissions read a task through sync although online detail was denied.
potentialImpact: After a same-project entity permission is revoked, init can continue returning data and client ACL cleanup only purges projects no longer visible.
recommendation: Define per-entity read policy and filter every pull by effective system/project capabilities; invalidate cached entity families when those grants are revoked.
acceptanceCriteria: Any entity denied by equivalent online read authorization is absent from sync response.
Revoking one entity permission in a still-visible project removes its cached rows and prevents future pulls.
Own-only reports remain restricted to their author.

title: 同步拉取受硬上限截断后仍推进时间游标
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: More than 3000 matching upserts or 5000 tombstones exist for a pull
Client accepts response cursor and next request starts after it

source.symbol: bounded entity queries and serverTime cursor

callPath: query each entity with gt since and take limit
unreturned rows fall behind next since

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated DB probe had 3001 qualifying tasks, returned 3000 then 0 next pull; not rerun.
The query/cursor window is confirmed statically; other commit-interleaving and tombstone-cap scenarios were not run.

counterevidenceChecked: Rows are ordered ascending by timestamp.
Project and soft-delete scopes are applied.
There is no stable ID tie-breaker, continuation token, or cap-completion signal.
observedImpact: Historical probe permanently omitted at least one qualifying task after advancing cursor beyond the capped result.
potentialImpact: Tombstone truncation, equal timestamps, and writes committed across read/cursor windows may also omit changes; these cases were not separately demonstrated.
recommendation: Use a fixed upper boundary, stable composite keyset pagination for each entity and tombstone stream, and advance the checkpoint only after every stream reaches that boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: More than 3000 upserts and 5000 tombstones are fully paged before checkpoint commit.
Equal timestamp rows are neither skipped nor duplicated.
A concurrent write is returned in this or the following pull, never behind an already committed cursor.
pendingQuestions: Choose/verify a database-consistent snapshot boundary or a change log whose visibility ordering handles late commits.

title: 新授权项目只更新同步 ACL，没有触发历史数据回填
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: GET /api/sync/init after project membership is added
preconditions: Client has a prior since cursor
Actor becomes a member of a live project with older rows
Rows have timestamps earlier than the old cursor

source.symbol: ProjectMember has joinedAt/leftAt and no updatedAt

callPath: init still queries old rows using client since
client only purges rows for removed project IDs
new project historical state remains absent

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated probe showed ACL included project but project and historical task upserts were empty; not rerun.
Current source supports join/backfill gap; leave/rejoin and membership-role changes were not dynamically probed.

counterevidenceChecked: ACL version hashes visible projects and permissions.
Client reacts to ACL change, but only deletes rows belonging to project IDs no longer visible.
ProjectMember timestampField is joinedAt; schema has no updatedAt/revision.
observedImpact: Historical probe left the newly authorized project and historical task absent from local sync payload despite ACL containing the project.
potentialImpact: ProjectMember role changes may not be represented as a later timestamp event; not separately tested.
recommendation: Represent authorization grants as versioned changes and require a scoped initial snapshot for each newly visible project before accepting its incremental cursor.
acceptanceCriteria: A user with an existing cursor who joins an old project receives its current project and historical rows.
Revoke/leave removes local data before the new ACL version is committed.
Leave/rejoin and role changes produce complete permission-aware refreshes.

title: 同步回执未绑定主体与载荷
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Actor is authenticated.
Actor knows an existing successful clientMutationId.
The stored mutation result is applied; payload or actor may differ from the original request.

source.symbol: push setup and global mutationId receipt prefetch
successful receipt replay before per-entity authorization
SyncMutation globally unique clientMutationId and no payload hash
HTTP scoped receipt and payload mismatch contract
MutationReceipt scope unique key and payloadHash

callPath: only otherwise read entity and check project/author/action authorization

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated PostgreSQL probe: same actor with different payload and an outsider replayed the known key; stored title stayed first-content. Not rerun; requires knowledge of the mutationId.
Current source confirms global lookup and authorization ordering; no evidence that random IDs are predictable or request body content is leaked.

counterevidenceChecked: The sync router requires authentication.
A user must know the prior successful mutationId.
HTTP MutationReceipt uses actor, command, resourceScope, key, and payloadHash; that model is not used by sync push.
observedImpact: Historical probe returned applied/replayed result metadata for a different payload and a different actor while leaving the original database title unchanged.
potentialImpact: A client can falsely believe different unsaved content was accepted; the stored response exposes entity result metadata. Key guessing and body disclosure were not demonstrated.
recommendation: Bind sync receipts to actor, command, resource scope, idempotency key, and canonical payload hash; reauthorize the current resource before receipt lookup; return conflict for same-scope key reuse with different payload.
acceptanceCriteria: Known key replay by another actor is denied after current resource authorization.
Same actor/resource/key with changed payload returns 409 and does not replay.
Same actor/resource/key with identical payload returns the original result.

title: 同步业务写入与成功回执非原子
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: POST /api/sync/push; entity write followed by SyncMutation upsert
preconditions: A mutation reaches a successful business write.
Receipt persistence fails after that write.

source.symbol: business writes and task-only inner transaction
receipt upsert, device update, and later aggregate audit
HTTP receipt and execute in one transaction

callPath: commit item business write (task subcommands may have an inner transaction)
after loop update device and emit best-effort aggregate audit

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated PostgreSQL fault injection after a real task SQL write: HTTP 500, committed title, zero receipt. Not rerun this turn.
Current route keeps task/report/generic business write and SyncMutation upsert outside one transaction; not every entity or failure point was fault-injected.

counterevidenceChecked: Mixed existing-task fields/status/assignee writes share a transaction.
Report HTTP commands use strict audit and receipt in a transaction.
Sync push processes mutations individually; the plan does not assume the entire batch must be atomic.
observedImpact: Historical injection caused an HTTP 500 after task content committed with no SyncMutation receipt, leaving client outcome ambiguous and permitting duplicate retry effects.
potentialImpact: The same split may affect other sync entity writes if their subsequent receipt persistence fails; this was not separately reproduced for each entity.
recommendation: For each mutation, put command validation/write, required strict audit, and scoped receipt creation/update in one transaction; preserve per-item batch semantics and make each outcome recoverable after connection loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Receipt persistence failure rolls back that mutation's business state and required audit.
Successful business write and success receipt commit together and can be replayed.
A partially completed multi-item batch reports/reconstructs each item without requiring all-batch rollback.
pendingQuestions: Specify the client recovery/query contract when a push response is lost after some per-item outcomes have committed.

title: 同步项目状态写入绕过归档权限与状态转换
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Authenticated project member has projects.update but lacks projects.archive.
A project is in PLANNING and mutation requests ARCHIVED.

source.symbol: project writable field list includes status and managerId
generic entity action guard only checks configured update permission
HTTP project status transition and archive permission checks

callPath: project status value is not handled by assertSyncEntityActions

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated probe changed PLANNING to ARCHIVED for MEMBER with only projects.update; not rerun.
Current code confirms project status remains on generic field path and lacks the HTTP-specific project archive/transition check.

counterevidenceChecked: Sync still requires authentication, visible project scope, membership capability, and projects.update.
HTTP project PUT checks projects.archive for archive and validates STATUS_TRANSITIONS.
observedImpact: Historical probe applied PLANNING→ARCHIVED for a project MEMBER with only projects.update.
potentialImpact: Other project status transitions may also bypass the HTTP transition allowlist; only the historical archive edge is dynamically established.
recommendation: Remove status from generic sync project patches and route it through the shared project transition command enforcing archive permission and allowed edges.
acceptanceCriteria: A projects.update-only MEMBER cannot archive by sync.
An actor with archive permission still cannot take an edge absent from STATUS_TRANSITIONS.
HTTP and sync apply identical authorization and transition rules.

title: 同步更新项目负责人时未同步负责人成员关系
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Actor can write the project and has projects.update.
The new managerId differs from the current value.

source.symbol: project generic update has no ProjectMember transfer
HTTP project update transaction upserts new manager and demotes prior manager
project capability resolution requires active ProjectMember except SUPER_ADMIN

callPath: sync project managerId passes writable field whitelist
managerId list visibility can differ from detail/write access resolved via active membership

evidence.limitation: Static comparison: HTTP explicitly synchronizes ProjectMember in same transaction whereas sync updates only Project. No dynamic manager-transfer probe this turn.

counterevidenceChecked: HTTP update's membership transfer is an explicit source-level invariant and transactional side effect.
projectAccess resolves non-SUPER_ADMIN capabilities from active ProjectMember; managerId is a separate visibility condition.
observedImpact: Source paths have divergent manager transfer semantics: sync changes Project.managerId without promoting the new manager or demoting the old one; capability resolution still requires active membership. No live request impact was dynamically measured.
potentialImpact: The new manager may be listed as able to see the project but lack detail/write access; old manager membership/capabilities can remain. Business policy may define an intentional exception, not found in the reviewed HTTP path.
recommendation: Route sync manager transfers through the same transactional command as HTTP, or document and consistently implement a policy allowing a manager without ProjectMember membership.
acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent managerId changes from HTTP and sync leave project.managerId and active ProjectMember roles consistent.
Resolver visibility and capability access for the new and previous manager match the documented policy.
Failure during membership synchronization rolls back the managerId change.
pendingQuestions: Confirm whether managerId is required to imply active MANAGER membership; current HTTP update/create paths implement that relationship.

title: 初始化身份时清理路径仍可能清空尚未同步的用户草稿
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: SyncProvider useEffect：user?.id 不存在时调用 engine.resetOnLogout()
preconditions: 页面初始化时 SyncProvider 的 user 为 null，身份恢复仍在进行
IndexedDB outbox 存在带 userId=A 的未同步变更
resetOnLogout 的清理先于 start(A) 完成

source.symbol: 按 uid 选择待保留 outbox
登出捕获主体、并清理 outbox

callPath: App 初始渲染 AuthProvider(user=null, bootstrapping)
SyncProvider 初始 user?.id 为空，effect 调 resetOnLogout()
fresh engine currentUserId=null；preservePendingForUser(null) 排除有 userId=A 的队列行
若清理先于 AuthProvider /me 成功并 start(A)，A 的离线变更没有保留副本

evidence.limitation: 历史实际引擎 + fake-indexeddb + 注入 transport；观察 outbox 1->0、用户拒绝区 0；无真实浏览器渲染或 React 启动时序验证。
本轮基线源码确认 null 引导和明确退出共用清理路径，且有主体字段的行不属于 null preserve 集合；具体浏览器触发时序待验证。

counterevidenceChecked: resetOnLogout 在第一个 await 前递增 sessionGen 并捕获 uidAtLogout。
若新会话先开始，代次检查会阻止旧 reset 尾部继续清理。
正常 start(userId) 会恢复该主体 deadLetters 并将显式 foreign outbox 隔离。
这些保护不改变首次 user=null 仍调用 resetOnLogout 的事实，也不避免 uidAtLogout=null 后的全局 outboxClear。
observedImpact: 历史离线引擎夹具观察到初始 null 用户触发清理后 outbox 由 1 变为 0，且无拒绝区副本，表明该触发序列会丢失待同步内容。
potentialImpact: 带真实会话的页面刷新在身份恢复慢于本地清理时可能删除 A 的离线变更；该浏览器启动窗口未实测。
recommendation: 将 bootstrapping 与显式 logout 分开；身份未恢复前禁止按匿名主体执行全局清理。退出保留与清除应按队列原 userId 在同一 IndexedDB 事务完成，并为未标主体旧行定义保守保全策略。
acceptanceCriteria: 断网刷新时 A 的待同步变更不因 bootstrapping 而清除。
显式退出后 A 的队列只能由 A 恢复，不由 B 代发；A 再登录可重试。
快速退出/登录时旧会话清理不能删除新账号数据。
pendingQuestions: 使用测试账号和临时浏览器目录验证有效 token + 慢/断网 /me + 预置带主体 outbox 的真实启动时序。

title: 实体缓存没有账号命名空间，缓存 API 可跨账号读取
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: engine.readCachedRecords(entity)；Tasks 页面 API 失败时的 tasks 缓存回退为静态消费者
preconditions: records 中存在其他账号拉取的 entity 记录
当前账号与旧记录账号共享项目可见性，或旧记录未被 ACL 清理
调用 readCachedRecords 的页面进入离线/API 失败回退（若主张页面影响）

source.symbol: records 全局 store 与 entity:id 主键约定
readCachedRecords 仅按 entity 过滤
同步拉取写入全局 entity:id 键
ACL 按项目可见性清理缓存
任务 API 失败时读取任务缓存

callPath: sync init -> applyPull -> recordsPutMany(entity:id) 写全局 records store
ACL 变化时仅清除当前主体不可见项目的数据；共享项目记录保留
readCachedRecords(entity) -> recordsAll -> entity 过滤，不接收/比较 userId
Tasks 页面 taskAPI.list 失败 -> readCachedRecords('tasks') -> setTasks
历史确定复现为报告记录通过缓存 API 跨账号可读；没有复现报告页面或 Tasks 页面跨账号展示

evidence.limitation: 历史实际引擎 + fake-indexeddb 证明 user-b 可通过 readCachedRecords 读到 user-a 创建的报告记录，sharedProjectStillAuthorized=true；没有浏览器渲染或报告 UI 展示证据。
本轮确认静态消费者为 Tasks 页面；该消费者请求 tasks 实体，不等于已证明 user-a 报告在报告 UI 显示给 user-b，也没有证明缓存任务为用户私有。

counterevidenceChecked: logout 清理会清全局 records，但同项目账号仍同时在线/切换窗口或该清理未先于读缓存完成时不提供主体隔离。
ACL 变化会清除当前账号不可见的项目数据，但共享项目可见的缓存保留。
deadLetters 具有 userId 主键/过滤；records 没有对应隔离。
当前报告页面未找到 readCachedRecords 消费者；Tasks 页面存在 tasks 实体回退调用，但本包未证实敏感任务的 UI 跨账号展示。
observedImpact: 历史缓存 API 层复现读取到前一账号创建的报告记录；记录并未证明报告 UI 显示、或用户看到其他账号报告正文。
potentialImpact: 共享设备和共享项目下，Tasks API 失败时页面会将本地 tasks 缓存写入页面状态；跨账号是否显示了应隔离的数据及其敏感性未验证。
recommendation: 将 records 纳入 userId 分区，或使每个读写 API 必须显式提供主体并以主体过滤；账号切换与 ACL 清理分开处理；schema 迁移保全未同步数据并保守处理旧记录归属。
acceptanceCriteria: 同一共享项目中 A 写入/拉取的缓存不会被 B 的缓存读取 API 返回。
在线请求失败时每个缓存消费者仅显示当前用户获准数据。
A 再登录可恢复其缓存；旧版本存储升级不会丢失 outbox。
pendingQuestions: 如需将 UI 影响从潜在提升为已观察，需用隔离测试数据分别覆盖共享项目任务缓存和报告实体页面，并记录页面可见字段；当前未运行。

title: 冲突先从 outbox 删除，再批量持久化冲突，写入失败会丢失本地修改
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: frontend offline engine.syncNow 收到 /sync/push 的 conflict result
preconditions: 服务端对 mutation 返回 conflict
客户端独立 outboxDelete 成功
该轮结束前 conflict kvSet 失败或进程中断

source.symbol: 冲突结果先删除 outbox 后仅缓存在内存
rejected 使用跨 store 原子移动的对照

callPath: syncNow 读取全量 outbox 并 push
收到 conflict 后 outboxDelete 单独提交
原 payload 只进入内存 nextConflicts
处理完所有结果后一次 kvSet(conflictKey, merged)
若该 kv 写入失败，磁盘 outbox 与旧冲突快照都不含该 payload

evidence.limitation: 历史实际前端引擎 + fake-indexeddb + 注入 transport；注入冲突存储失败后 outboxAfter=0、persistedConflicts=0；不是浏览器 E2E。
本轮当前基线源码确认删除与快照写入使用不同事务；未本轮运行失败注入。

counterevidenceChecked: applied 收到服务端成功回执后删除 outbox。
rejected 通过 idb.deadLetterMove 在 deadLetters 与 outbox 两个 object store 的同一事务内迁移。
冲突对象确实包含原本地 change payload，会话代次也阻止过期主体回包写入；两者均不能覆盖先删后存的同主体持久化失败窗口。
observedImpact: 历史注入结果观察到服务端返回冲突后，后续冲突存储失败使 outbox 与已持久化冲突都为零；本地未接受变更的 payload 不再有本地恢复副本。
potentialImpact: 实际浏览器在 IDB quota/事务错误或关闭时是否触发相同窗口，历史运行不是浏览器场景；源码操作顺序已确认该窗口存在。
recommendation: 将冲突记录和 outbox 删除放入同一 IndexedDB readwrite transaction；若冲突存储采用快照，应改为逐条持久化、幂等移动，并在事务提交前保留原 outbox。
acceptanceCriteria: 冲突记录写入失败时原 outbox 项仍在；事务提交成功后只存在一份可恢复的 conflict payload。
对存储失败点重启后验证 payload 可再次处置；重复回包不丢失且不重复产生冲突副本。
pendingQuestions: 以真实浏览器 IndexedDB 对冲突写事务失败和页面中止进行验收；当前未运行。

title: 离线出队没有分批，超过服务端 500 条限制后队列无法推进
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: frontend offline engine.syncNow 将 outbox 全量传给 POST /sync/push
preconditions: outbox 超过 500 条
syncNow 被调用

source.symbol: 读取全量 outbox 并构造单个 push 请求
SyncChange DTO 无依赖/序号字段
push 原样 POST 完整 payload
服务端拒绝超过 500 条

callPath: syncNow 从 outbox getAll 取所有记录
不切批，映射为单一 changes 数组并请求 /sync/push
服务端解析 changes 后在逐项业务处理前检查长度 > 500 并拒绝
客户端 catch 网络/HTTP 错误，不处理逐项结果，outbox 保持不变
后续同步重复发送同一超限批次，没有客户端前进路径

evidence.limitation: 历史真实前端引擎 + fake-indexeddb + 注入 transport；观测 501 条请求命中模拟 500 条限制且队列仍为 501；不是完整网络 E2E。

evidence.ref: execution/R08/review.md#F04：超过服务器单批 500 条后队列无法推进
evidence.limitation: 当前源码确认前端无切批、服务端限制 500；请求字节限制来自部署环境，本轮未确定。

counterevidenceChecked: HTTP/传输失败不会按未收到的结果删除队列，因此数据保留。
服务端按 mutation ID 回放 applied 回执，提供逐项重试的幂等能力。
以上保护不改变超过 500 条的请求整体被服务端拒绝，也没有创建后续批次。
observedImpact: 历史探针记录 501 条被一次发送，模拟服务端 500 条上限拒绝后 outbox 保持 501，错误为 server limit: 500 changes。
potentialImpact: 在实际代理或运行环境另有请求体字节上限时，较少但 payload 很大的批次也可能被拒绝；当前部署限额未检查。
recommendation: 定义 count 与 byte 两类批次上限，按明确依赖顺序切片；仅在校验本批所有 mutation 回执后持久化对应状态，再进入下一批。超时保留未确认行并按原幂等 ID 重试。
acceptanceCriteria: 501/1001 条队列可分批推进，批间失败只保留未确认与依赖未满足的项目。
父子实体依赖顺序有协议表达并按需等待；字节预算达到阈值时主动切批。
响应缺项、重复 mutationId、未知 status、超时均不得删除未确认 payload；重启后状态仍一致。
pendingQuestions: 生产反向代理/应用 body byte limit 未查证。
完整实体依赖图与部署网络请求体阈值需在实现验收阶段核实。

title: 汇报提交版本快照可能落后于最终正文
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: 事务外读取 report 后、提交事务内创建版本前发生并发草稿保存
或对已 SUBMITTED 报告以新 idempotency key 再次提交

source.symbol: 事务外读取report并把捕获快照传入submitReport
快照取传入content，状态更新where仅含id
版本/状态/审计/receipt在同一事务但不自动绑定外部读取revision

callPath: 授权后withIdempotency建立新命令事务
validate仅拒REVIEWED，不验证来源状态或revision
submitReport从捕获content写版本，按id无条件改为SUBMITTED

evidence.limitation: 历史隔离PostgreSQL受控交错观测最终正文与版本正文不同、另一个key重复提交200；本轮未重跑，不代表线上频率。
当前源仍有事务外快照+命令无条件按id更新；未在当前轮做并发运行验证。

counterevidenceChecked: 有key时业务版本、状态、严格审计、receipt在withIdempotency同一事务；同key重试会回放。
报告保存接口支持updatedAt CAS，但submit route没有调用该CAS。
submit validate仅拒REVIEWED，故SUBMITTED不阻断新key。
observedImpact: 历史交错观察到SUBMITTED后当前正文为concurrent-save而提交版本仍为before；再次用不同key提交SUBMITTED报告仍返回200。
potentialImpact: 审批/审计查看的历史提交证据可能不代表提交成功时最终正文；是否造成实际业务损失未证明。
recommendation: 提交事务内基于来源状态与expected revision执行条件更新；版本快照复制同一成功CAS修订；状态、版本、关键审计、回执统一事务。明确禁止无业务依据的重复提交。
acceptanceCriteria: 控制保存与提交交错时，快照与成功提交的同一revision一致；过期基线返回409且不留版本/receipt。
已SUBMITTED记录以新幂等键提交按状态规则拒绝。
并发版本分配不会产生重复版本或部分状态。
pendingQuestions: 数据库默认隔离下并发修订/version竞态需在隔离环境受控验证。
复提合法来源状态须由产品/审批规则确认；当前代码未证明其业务意图。

title: 在线任务修改未应用客户端并发基线
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: 客户端基于旧任务修订编辑
服务端已有较新修订
旧客户端提交更新

source.symbol: HTTP PUT拆字段/状态/指派并调用commands但未传cas

evidence.limitation: 历史隔离PostgreSQL探针提交旧expectedUpdatedAt，观测HTTP 200且title被覆盖；本轮未重跑。
当前route仍不解析或传递cas；source-only path confirmation this round。

counterevidenceChecked: taskCommands中三类命令支持CAS过滤和409。
PUT把普通字段、状态和指派放同一业务事务防部分命令提交。
sync使用服务端观察的时间戳CAS（R06）；这不构成HTTP client baseline。
observedImpact: 历史请求在服务端已有较新值时携带旧expectedUpdatedAt仍获200并写入stale-overwrite。
potentialImpact: 并发编辑的后写旧版本可能覆盖较新任务数据，客户端不获冲突提示。

静态审阅未逐字段或任务状态并发复现。

title: 法规原文读取别名绕过统一下载入口的感染状态阻断
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Authenticated actor has regulatory_documents.view
Regulatory document and active original Attachment/FileObject exist
FileObject.scanStatus is INFECTED

source.symbol: shared file download and infection guard

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated route probe used a benign text fixture labeled INFECTED; generic download 403 and alias returned bytes; not rerun.
Current alias checks resource scope and soft delete but not scanStatus; generic route explicitly blocks INFECTED.

counterevidenceChecked: Both paths require authentication and their respective system permission.
Alias applies FileAccessPolicy and checks attachment/FileObject soft deletion.
Current frontend uses the shared /files/:id download endpoint, but the compatibility server route remains reachable.
observedImpact: Historical probe retrieved bytes of a FileObject marked INFECTED through the regulatory original-file alias while the generic route denied it.
potentialImpact: Legacy fallback may return a matching old disk file when the FileObject read path errors; same-object relationship and scan state were not established.
recommendation: Route every object and compatibility download through a shared service that performs scope authorization, deleted-state checks, scan policy, storage read, and audit.
acceptanceCriteria: INFECTED files are rejected by /files/:id, /files/:id/download, and regulatory original-file alias.
Scan policy for FAILED and SKIPPED states is explicit and does not imply a scan passed.
All denied infected reads emit the required audit event.

title: 项目文件策略丢失 elevated 上下文并拒绝超管非成员访问
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: GET /api/files/:id/metadata; same project access context is also used for downloads and deletes
preconditions: Actor is SUPER_ADMIN with files.download
File scope is PROJECT with live owner project
Actor is not a ProjectMember

source.symbol: resolver returns elevated for SUPER_ADMIN nonmember

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated route probe observed ordinary project detail 200 and project file metadata 404; not rerun.
Current route strips elevated flag and current policy rejects isMember=false before checking capabilities.

counterevidenceChecked: Project files are not globally readable to ordinary nonmembers.
The project resolver deliberately represents SUPER_ADMIN nonmember access as elevated with full capabilities.
File policy does not special-case SUPER_ADMIN in PROJECT scope and file handler does not emit elevated read audit.
observedImpact: Historical probe confirmed SUPER_ADMIN could access ordinary project detail but received 404 for metadata of a file owned by that nonmember project.
potentialImpact: The same context conversion is used by file download/delete; only metadata denial was historically observed.
recommendation: Pass the complete project access decision to file policy and preserve the elevated flag; write sensitive-read audit for approved SUPER_ADMIN nonmember file access.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary nonmembers remain denied.
Project members are evaluated using the declared project role and file scope.
SUPER_ADMIN nonmember access requires the intended system permission and emits elevated audit.

title: 任务父子关系允许跨项目
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: 已认证主体对项目B可写
mutation 的 projectId 为B
parentId 指向项目A的一条 task
该 task 未被其他业务校验拒绝

source.symbol: tasks sync entity schema permits parentId
task-specific guard validates phase but not parent project or cycle
Task parent relation is parentId-to-id only
task parent FK references id only

callPath: database FK validates only parent id existence

evidence.limitation: Historical isolated database probe observed cross-project parent accepted; not rerun in this packet.
Current source and schema preserve the path; no live database probe or current data query was performed.

counterevidenceChecked: Sync still requires authentication, visible project scope, task action permission and project write capability.
HTTP task create/update does not accept parentId.
Phase references receive a same-project guard, but parentId does not.
The task FK enforces parent existence only.
observedImpact: Historical evidence confirms a project B task can reference a parent task in project A, violating a project-local task-tree invariant.
potentialImpact: Cross-project parent edges may make tree traversal or cascade-like application logic cross a project boundary. No evidence proves an actor can delete another project's task; that boundary is preserved.
recommendation: Route all parent writes through a shared command that validates same-project, live parent and acyclicity; add a composite projectId/id uniqueness target and composite FK if supported by the chosen migration design. Before migration, produce read-only reports of cross-project edges, orphans, cycles and tombstone references and decide their disposition.
acceptanceCriteria: Sync and online paths reject parent links across projects.
All cycle lengths are rejected while valid same-project trees remain writable.
Recursive operations carry projectId and cannot cross project scope.
Legacy anomalous edges are reconciled only under an approved data plan.
pendingQuestions: What remediation policy applies to existing cross-project edges, cycles and references to tombstoned parents?
Can the selected Prisma/PostgreSQL migration add composite relation constraints without unacceptable locking?

title: 恢复接口跳过重复唯一键记录却虚报恢复成功数量
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Payload contains rows with distinct primary keys but the same constrained unique value, as in duplicate usernames.
Rows are classified as new because their primary keys are absent from the target database.

source.symbol: project phase and transition unique constraints

evidence.limitation: Static review at unchanged baseline; no current restore was executed.
Historical isolated database probe reports previewOk=true, reportedCreated=2, actualCreated=1; not a production database result.

counterevidenceChecked: Payload primary keys are checked for absence and duplicates.
Some single-column unique values are checked against existing rows, but payload-internal duplicate unique values and composite uniques are not covered by the metadata contract.
Database constraints and one transaction can reject non-skipped invalid writes and roll the transaction back.
Restore is restricted to SUPER_ADMIN and replace requires explicit confirmation; these guards do not correct merge duplicate skipping or the count.
observedImpact: Historical isolated reproduction showed two payload users with a duplicate username pass preview, while the restore response reported two creates and the database contained one inserted row; unchanged current code still counts input rows after skipDuplicates.
potentialImpact: Other unique or composite-unique collisions represented by the database but absent from the validator metadata may be silently skipped by createMany; this broader set was not dynamically exercised.
recommendation: Make the complete primary-key, unique-key, composite-key, and FK contract derive from one schema-aware registry; detect payload-internal and target conflicts without truncation; fail and roll back unexpected conflicts; return actual database affected counts and post-restore reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-table reported inserted/updated/deleted counts equal database effects for every supported table.
Duplicate payload values for every single and composite unique constraint are rejected before writes or cause explicit full rollback.
Test the 500/501 check boundary and target changes between preview and apply in isolated environments.
Reconcile restored primary keys, unique keys, FKs, and attachment/file references before reporting success.
pendingQuestions: No current baseline rerun; the historical reproduction is inherited as sufficient for disposition.

title: 文件备份将新快照做成旧快照软链并可能改写历史内容
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: An existing latest symlink is present when a subsequent uploads snapshot is started.

evidence.limitation: Static command path is current; no target Linux command execution.
Disposable-directory reproduction on macOS 27 arm64 only; does not establish target Linux or production damage.

counterevidenceChecked: Database dump is checked with pg_restore -l and gets SHA-256; this does not verify immutable uploads snapshots.
observedImpact: Historical macOS isolated test produced a symlink for snapshot two and changed snapshot one's observed content; production impact is unverified.
potentialImpact: If target Linux follows the same path semantics, later rsync --delete can mutate the prior snapshot and break DB/files pairing.
recommendation: Create a real staging directory, use the resolved prior snapshot only as rsync --link-dest, create and verify a content manifest, then atomically publish immutable dated snapshot and latest; preserve and quarantine existing snapshots before changes.
acceptanceCriteria: On target Linux in a disposable path, after two add/change/delete rounds, first snapshot manifest and bytes remain unchanged and the second is complete before latest is advanced.
pendingQuestions: Target Linux distribution, cp/rsync versions and production storage semantics have not been verified.

title: 候选风险：数据库 dump 与 uploads 文件快照没有共同恢复点协调
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Application writes affecting both file metadata/attachments and uploads can continue during backup collection.

source.symbol: file binaries external to database and relational FileObject metadata

evidence.limitation: The code provides no write barrier/common snapshot identifier; the exact concurrent mutation outcome was not reproduced.

counterevidenceChecked: The script comment says database and uploads should be backed up at the same frequency, but no shared checkpoint or coordinated snapshot mechanism is implemented in this script.
observedImpact: 本轮未观察到运行时不一致；仅确认脚本内数据库与文件采集是顺序步骤且没有共享 checkpoint。
potentialImpact: 若应用写入在两项采集之间持续运行，配对恢复可能呈现不同状态；实际运行条件和影响尚未证实。
recommendation: Bind DB and files to a runId and proven common checkpoint using a write barrier or coordinated versioned snapshots; record dump hash, file manifest hash, and post-restore row/reference/checksum reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: An isolated test with adjacent file metadata and binary add/change/delete operations proves a paired restore is coherent, and a mismatched pair/checksum is rejected before acceptance.
pendingQuestions: 确认实际备份期间业务写入是否持续，以及运维平台是否在脚本外提供共同快照/写入屏障；之后用隔离配对恢复演练判定是否形成缺陷。

title: 发布前检查校验旧版本而非候选版本
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
preconditions: Candidate differs from current release in a contract checked by preflight.
Deploy invokes preflight without candidate REPO_ROOT/APP_DIR/WEB_DIR and does not repeat the same contract gate after clone/build.

source.symbol: preflight precedes clone and candidate path assertion

evidence.limitation: Static review of unchanged baseline; no deployment/preflight command was run.
Historical static finding; no evidence that a production candidate was incorrectly released.

counterevidenceChecked: Candidate directory, npm install, Prisma migration status and build output are checked later.
These later gates do not run the complete preflight contract against the candidate before migration/cutover.
observedImpact: The configured preflight gate examines current by default rather than the release candidate; therefore its pass cannot establish that the candidate satisfies the inspected source/schema/seed contracts.
potentialImpact: A candidate-only contract defect can pass the pre-release gate; actual production failure or data impact is not established.
recommendation: Separate host checks from artifact checks. After clone and before migration, pass candidate REPO_ROOT/APP_DIR/WEB_DIR to a candidate contract gate and bind its result to an immutable release/build manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: An isolated candidate-only contract failure blocks before database migration and symlink cutover while current remains healthy.
Successful gate records the same candidate commit/build identity later served by health/readiness and smoke.
pendingQuestions: No candidate-gate failure-injection run was performed in this read-only package.

title: 部署配置检查与运行时配置不一致
head: 138cf2da1b63195cef7e884f69bdf8ded6ed3c21
entrypoint: systemd EnvironmentFile to backend createApp CORS setup; preflight checks deployment variables
preconditions: Operator configures ALLOWED_ORIGINS as shown in template and checked by preflight but does not separately set CORS_ORIGINS.
Operator assumes ENABLE_BACKUP_EXPORT=false is enforced by application code.

source.symbol: template CORS and backup export variables
runtime consumes CORS_ORIGINS with wildcard fallback

callPath: createApp reads CORS_ORIGINS only for CORS

evidence.limitation: Static current-source review only; real .env and runtime headers/settings were deliberately not inspected.
Historical static finding; production configuration and behavior were not observed.

counterevidenceChecked: Preflight rejects ALLOWED_ORIGINS='*' in production.
Backup export endpoint has separate authorization controls; this finding does not establish unauthenticated access or direct data exfiltration.
observedImpact: Configuration names differ between the deployment check/template and runtime CORS consumer; backend/src does not consume ENABLE_BACKUP_EXPORT, so passing that preflight check alone does not demonstrate an application behavior change.
potentialImpact: If only the documented variable is configured, runtime CORS falls back to '*'; actual production configuration and browser impact remain unverified. The export flag may provide a false assurance but no unauthenticated export is established.
recommendation: Use one typed configuration schema shared by application and preflight. Remove unused flags or connect them to a defined authorized behavior and test the effective runtime behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Isolated configuration with only documented names yields the documented CORS allowlist and rejects unlisted origins.
Preflight and runtime reject missing/invalid production config consistently.
If export control is retained, authorized requests demonstrate matching behavior for enabled and disabled modes.
pendingQuestions: Actual production variables are unknown because the live .env was not read.
No runtime CORS or export request was executed.
